jobs.title: Data Engineer – Healthcare
jobs.description: About PAICON PAICON is a Heidelberg-based health data intelligence company building the global health data foundation through its PaiX ecosystem, working to close the representation gap in medical data so personalised medicine works for everyone. We harmonise ethically approved, GDPR compliant real-world health data from providers around the world into a global dataset. The data covers multiple modalities on various disease entities. Our flagship product, PaiX Navigator, generates actionable insights for pharma, biotech and AI companies worldwide. The role We are looking for a hands-on data engineer to integrate data from our global partners into our platform. Data integration is the core of the role, and agentic AI tooling is part of how we do it. This is an on-site position in our Heidelberg office. You will work closely with medical, engineering and commercialization colleagues in a small, pragmatic team with short decision paths and direct access to the founders. What you'll do Onboard new data partners, from first assessment of their data through to reliable production ingestion Map partner data to our internal data model and work with providers to close gaps Build and maintain robust, well-tested data pipelines Ensure high standards in data quality and help evolve our database and data infrastructure Document data and transformations so that every step is transparent and traceable Ensure data is handled securely, de-identified and in line with healthcare data regulations Help us apply AI-assisted methods to data integration, with appropriate quality checks What you bring Several years of hands-on data engineering, including building and running production data pipelines Strong SQL and relational database design skills R and Python skills on Linux systems Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as HL7 FHIR and common clinical coding systems Understanding of data privacy and security in a regulated environment, including GDPR Day-to-day use of AI-assiste

jobs.title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
jobs.description: Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future. Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform. We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems. We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role. Responsibilities Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation. Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance. Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers. Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation. Requirements Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch. Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering. Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. Wat ga je doen? Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt. Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken. Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten. Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk.
